name: Faren Blackspirit
original_name: ファーレーン・ブラックスピリット
source:
"I have to make sure to mind my manners."

Her distinguishing feature is her thick eyebrows that make her strong will evident. At the same time, she has a gen tel and graceful femininity to her.

However, she doesn't show the slightest mercy on the battlefield.
